shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,140p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && printf '\\n--- catalog matches ---\\n' && rg -n -i -C 2 'dashboard|data grid|table|app shell|navigation' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && printf '\\n--- project ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- app ---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- traps ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"for (const p of ['@gravity-ui/uikit','@gravity-ui/table','@gravity-ui/navigation']) console.log(p,require(p+'/package.json').version)\" && printf '\\n--- table docs candidates ---\\n' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/{dist/docs,build/docs} 2>/dev/null && printf '\\n--- navigation docs candidates ---\\n' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/{dist/docs,build/docs} 2>/dev/null && printf '\\n--- package routing entries ---\\n' && sed -n '367,385p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && sed -n '452,469p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && printf '\\n--- readmes ---\\n' && rg -n -C 3 'Required setup|ColumnReorderingProvider|group|selection|AsideHeader|menuItems|styles' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "for p in uikit table navigation; do node -p \"require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/"'$p/package.json'"').version\"; done
printf '\\n--- table docs ---\\n'
find node_modules/@gravity-ui/table -path '*/docs/INDEX.md' -o -name README.md | head -12
printf '\\n--- navigation docs ---\\n'
find node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation -path '*/docs/INDEX.md' -o -name README.md | head -12
printf '\\n--- readmes matches ---\\n'
rg -n -C 3 'Required setup|ColumnReorderingProvider|group|selection|AsideHeader|menuItems|styles' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- package peer/setup ---' && sed -n '1,75p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/README.md && sed -n '20,70p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- table docs grouping / reordering / table render ---' && rg -n -C 4 'getGroupedRowModel|Grouping|ColumnReorderingProvider|selectionColumn|<Table|Table table|Table className|TableProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -180 && printf '%s\\n' '--- navigation docs index ---' && rg -n -C 4 'AsideHeader|renderContent|menuItems|compact|onChangeCompact|styles' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -160 && printf '%s\\n' '--- icons dependencies ---' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "npm ls @gravity-ui/icons @bem-react/classname --depth=0; sed -n '288,354p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/README.md; sed -n '482,508p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/README.md; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md; rg -n 'export.*(House|Person|Package|Gear|List|Cart|Box|Users|ShoppingCart|HandTruck|CreditCard)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons -g 'index.d.ts' | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "npm install @gravity-ui/icons @bem-react/classname && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -110 && rg -n 'export.*(Button|Text|Label|Icon|Checkbox|TextInput)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'styles.css|Table styles|@gravity-ui/table/styles' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/package.json; rg -n 'export.*TextInput|export.*Button|export.*Text' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/index.d.ts; rg -n 'interface TextInputProps|type TextInputProps|interface ButtonProps|type ButtonProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -g '*.d.ts' | head -30; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/package.json | sed -n '1,100p'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -- '--g-color-base-(info|positive|warning|misc|danger)-light|--g-color-text-(positive|warning|info|misc|danger)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -60; git status --short; cat package.json"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff --stat && git status --short && nl -ba src/App.tsx | sed -n '1,30p' && nl -ba src/App.css | sed -n '1,30p'"
